steps.en: Clone the skill, install ffmpeg, and put an ElevenLabs key in .env
steps.zh: 克隆 skill、装 ffmpeg、把 ElevenLabs 密钥写入 .env

steps.en: Registers as a skill whose helpers sit next to SKILL.md
steps.zh: 把整个目录注册为 skill，helpers 就在 SKILL.md 旁边

steps.en: Point the agent at a folder of raw takes and ask it to edit
steps.zh: 让 agent 对着素材文件夹开始剪
steps.code: edit these into a launch video

steps.en: Transcribes with Scribe and packs a phrase-level reading view
steps.zh: 用 Scribe 转写，打成逐句可读的 takes_packed.md

steps.en: Confirm the plain-English strategy before any cut
steps.zh: 先用白话确认策略，再允许动刀

steps.en: Writes an EDL, renders, self-evals at cut boundaries, and drops final.mp4
steps.zh: 写出 EDL，渲染并在每个切点自检，落到 final.mp4

value.en: You stop watching the timeline yourself; the agent cuts from a transcript you can read, after you approve the plan
value.zh: 你不用自己盯时间轴；agent 读一份转写稿来剪，而且动刀前要你点头
